settings.tab_content: 100% full-grain vegetable tanned leather from Tuscany, Italy. Tanned with natural chestnut and mimosa extracts.
Stitched using 0.8mm tiger thread. Every knot is hand cast and back-stitched to prevent unraveling.
Solid sand-cast brass hardware that develops a dark, organic patina over years of use.
If a stitch breaks or hardware fails, ship it back to our workshop. We repair it free of charge for life.
